purpose: Teach: 司祭/殿下/教皇/暗黒/破滅/連行/暴落/批准

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、中世の司祭の役割を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the role of medieval priests, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Gentle affirmation—not a test. Asuka's attention is genuinely on Sakura's work. Steady, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、王室の殿下の生活を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the daily life of royal princes.
lines.style: Direct and composed. Sakura meets the question head-on, no hedging. Clear voice, steady eye contact. Respectful but not deferential—she's confident in her work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ローマ教皇の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you explored papal history through that lens, right?
lines.style: Soft confirmation, like Asuka is drawing out the thread. Thoughtful, slightly curious—she's listening to how Sakura frames her research, not just checking boxes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、暗黒時代の社会を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined how that shaped society during the Dark Ages.
lines.style: Clear, articulate response. Sakura's steady—she knows her material. No uncertainty in delivery. Professional student tone, engaged but not performative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 帝国の破滅を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You also covered the fall of the empire in your research?
lines.style: Engaged and slightly impressed. Asuka's checking in on the scope of Sakura's work. Genuine curiosity underneath—wondering how deep Sakura went. Warm attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、反逆者の連行を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, specifically how political dissidents were handled during that period.
lines.style: Precise and confident. Sakura's specificity shows she's done the work. Not defensive—just clear. She's meeting Asuka's engagement with her own.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 市場の暴落を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Even looked at the economic collapse alongside all that?
lines.style: Light surprise and respect in the question. Asuka's noticing the breadth of Sakura's research. Conversational but attentive—she's genuinely impressed by the scope.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、条約の批准過程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I traced how the treaty ratification process both reflected and accelerated those economic shifts.
lines.style: Final response carries quiet sophistication. Sakura's showing her synthesis—not just listing topics, but understanding their connections. Assured, polished delivery. Subtle satisfaction that her work went this deep.
